##### Project general facts

Creek Waters 2 rises as a sleek residential tower on Creek Island, presenting a varied collection that spans refined apartments, generous townhouses and a sophisticated penthouse, all anchored by a striking amenities podium. The design emphasizes contemporary urban living, with each unit crafted to meet the expectations of discerning occupants while offering sweeping views of the surrounding skyline. Notable features include expansive rooftop terraces for the townhouses and a high‑end duplex on the uppermost levels that incorporates a dedicated study space.

The podium serves as a vibrant hub, housing boutique retail outlets, upscale dining venues and welcoming cafés that cater to daily needs and social gatherings. Direct pathways link these amenities to the wider promenade, extending the selection of shopping and leisure experiences beyond the immediate complex. Additional communal provisions create seamless indoor‑outdoor flow throughout the development.

Residences are delivered unfurnished, showcasing modern finishes fashioned from premium materials that convey a sense of understated elegance. Kitchens come fully equipped, enabling effortless culinary endeavors. The overall interior palette balances sleek minimalism with subtle warmth, enhancing the contemporary ambiance.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Creek Harbour positions itself at the heart of a dynamic district that will soon host a full suite of premier schools, vibrant lifestyle venues and diverse entertainment options. Convenient transport corridors link the neighbourhood seamlessly to the wider city, ensuring swift journeys across Dubai. An adjacent amenities podium grants immediate access to a curated mix of retail boutiques, restaurants and cafés, extending the everyday experience.

Set along the historic waters of Dubai Creek, the community enjoys a pedestrian‑friendly layout that encourages strolling and outdoor activity. Sprawling green zones covering roughly five hundred thousand square metres intersperse the residential blocks, offering ample parks and open spaces. The nearby Creek Island promenade provides a scenic backdrop for leisurely walks while linking to broader shopping and leisure destinations.

With an impressive residential footprint of roughly seven point four million square metres, the area accommodates a diverse mix of homes, from sleek apartments to generous townhouses. Sustainability underpins the master plan, embedding eco‑friendly design principles throughout the neighbourhood. Residents benefit from a balanced ecosystem of retail, business, recreation and community facilities, all within comfortable walking distance.
